## #1 — tg_jp — 2011-11-16
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7885/post-65163>

DOF Target.js

hello

it's a polygon script to set automatically 'distance' parameter of DOF tag. this set 'distance' paramter of DOF tag attached active camera, when it's updated.

download -> http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=77

if you use this for animation, you have to animate 'update timer' parameter of this object ( ex. 0 -> 1 ) or animate other parameters ( position/rotation/scale ).

update: fixed a bug may cause crash while rendering.

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

Links: http://www.tres-graficos.jp/blog/files/article.php?id=77

## #2 — ozzymandiaas — 2011-11-17
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/7885/post-65177>

Wow tg_jp, thanks a million! This is absolutely awesome! I've been struggling with squirrelly dof distances for awhile.

as you can see in the pics, i made a ball the target of the camera and then also made it the parent of the DOF target. I then moved both cam and ball all over the place and the DOF plane stays in perfect lockstep!!

BRILLIANT SCRIPT!
